purpose: Extend the source-backed Module -> Practice -> Tool Task -> Evidence -> Review -> Rework -> Validation architecture for the remaining lesson-backed accessibility module. Tool-workflow modules without dedicated source lessons remain explicit source gaps.
rules: Definitions below translate existing lesson Learn/Check/Figma or Framer Practice/Rework sections into gates.
No missing lesson content is invented.
Validation remains provisional until curriculum-level review.
B13-M01 and B14-M01 remain source gaps because the current lesson set does not contain dedicated Figma- or Framer-industry-workflow source lessons.

modules.practice: Apply specialized inclusive and accessibility considerations to a real interface context, accounting for varied abilities, developmental context, language/literacy, locale and writing direction, sensory/input alternatives, magnification, motor effort and cognitive or sensory load.
modules.toolTask: Choose one Figma/Framer flow and create targeted variants or stress states for the relevant context: older-adult needs, child/developmental context, language/literacy, localization/RTL, voice/conversational fallback, multimodal alternatives, low vision, motor access or neurodiversity. Document what changes, what remains consistent and why.
evidence: Rationale tied to the selected capability
review: The selected capability is relevant to the task/context
Design changes respond to concrete barriers rather than stereotypes
Alternative perception/input paths are provided where required
Language, locale, direction or content variation is handled without fragile fixed layouts
Safety, privacy, recovery or user-control considerations are explicit where relevant
Claims are separated from validated evidence
modules.validation: Learner can apply a specialized inclusive or accessibility capability to an interface, explain the context-specific design reasoning, and identify what still requires testing or validation.

sourceGaps.reason: The current physical lesson inventory contains Figma/Framer practice embedded across lessons, but no dedicated source lesson set defining a complete Figma industry workflow module.
sourceGaps.requiredNextStep: Define or import an authoritative Figma workflow source before creating final module-level practice/evidence gates.
